== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-L-angerfearaggression-pre.gif]]) and the Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-77E-Anger_Fear_Aggression.png]]) show the original text.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013), Light Side. Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table with up to 15 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Four times per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). Unless canceling your Interrupt, opponent may not play Uncertain Is The Future until the end of your first turn.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1240_78</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
